workload_selection.rationale: General decode/epilogue operator: use controlled `random` (512 in / 256 out @ concurrency=32) to lock steady-state batch size and minimize run-to-run variance.
workload_selection.cross_check_rationale: Prefill cross-check: this call site runs during prefill too, and a decode-only win can hide a prefill regression at large T.

l0_microbenchmark.scope: historical_only; isolated implementation, not a retest of the host kernel introduced by PR #81

serving_end_to_end.scope: operator serving A/B; not MOD acceptance

device_retests.scope: isolated operator, synthetic historical shapes on current runtime; model integration, L4 and service not retested

generic_verifier.limitation: device transfer may compact CPU views; layout validation is provided by stride-preserving graph cases

measurement.timing: NPU event per replay, alternating order

limitations: event timing per graph replay includes replay scheduling gaps
no memory peak measurement or service conclusion

archive.graph_result_note: Runner exit zero requires per-case status inspection; compilation failures are retained, not accepted timings.
